paper_title: RACER: Rich Language-Guided Failure Recovery Policies for Imitation Learning

user_space_xvfb.note: The conda Xvfb builds tested here did not expose a usable GLX visual; the Ubuntu-matched package is extracted without sudo.

user_space_virtualgl_egl.backend: EGL device selected through EGL_CUDA_DEVICE_NV mapping to the physical nvidia-smi actor GPU
user_space_virtualgl_egl.system_changes: none; Debian package is checksum-verified and extracted in user space

spawn_isolation_fallback.delivery: implemented and statically/protocol tested; real simulator gates remain queued behind the resource gate
spawn_isolation_fallback.semantic_boundary: Only the rollout module RLBenchSim symbol is rebound. The official policy, evaluator loop, simulator, RLBench, PyRep, and CoppeliaSim sources are unchanged.
spawn_isolation_fallback.transport: authenticated AF_UNIX multiprocessing connection to a clean exec-created Python worker
spawn_isolation_fallback.natural_exit_requirement: explicit simulator close and worker status 0 for initialization consistency and gated/full evaluation
spawn_isolation_fallback.observation_gate: exact full snapshot equality for supported finite values, with ndarray dtype, shape, and contiguous-byte SHA-256 fingerprints
spawn_isolation_fallback.attempt_limit: one claimed fallback path per supervisor ID; one fixed episode-0 attempt with retry-for-InvalidActionError=0; fail closed without retry
spawn_isolation_fallback.protocol_test_result: 14/14 passed in the actor environment without launching CoppeliaSim or using a GPU; includes success=false, fake/wrong-size GIF, wrong-shape/non-finite/degenerate point cloud, timeout and residual-process negatives plus natural worker-lifecycle evidence

language_service_port_adapter.reason: Port 8000 is occupied by the resident XPolicy Eval service on this workstation.
language_service_port_adapter.semantic_boundary: The wrapper imports the official app and changes only the Uvicorn host and port; model loading, routes, request schema, and inference remain unchanged.

local_reproduction_status.failure_boundary: After model services, actor checkpoint load, and Agent Reset; during the first RLBench reset and before any episode-0 result.

renderer_diagnostics.code_changes: none to pinned RACER, RLBench, PyRep, CoppeliaSim, or DynaMAC

i1.conclusion: A real pre-policy task render avoids the reset crash but changes 3 of 4 RGB observations, so it is not semantics-neutral.

k1.conclusion: A tiny supported GLX context lets random and fixed resets pass, but the process aborts after atexit with an invalid free.

k2.conclusion: Using one Conda X11 closure preserves the functional passes but does not remove the post-atexit invalid free.

renderer_diagnostics.stop_decision: No tested Xvfb/software-Mesa adapter provides reset stability, observation fidelity, and natural status 0 together; do not run the 75-episode target on this renderer.

queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.gate: one fixed place_cups episode 0 through the official evaluator with natural status 0, success=true, and zero evaluator retries
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.unlock_condition: success=true, one metrics record, one success marker, four nonempty camera GIFs, and no native-renderer failure signature
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.full_target: three tasks x 25 fixed episodes with retry-for-InvalidActionError=5; starts only after the gate passes
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.full_retry_protocol: 5 is the released rollout.py default and official scripts/eval_racer.sh does not override it; gates deliberately override it to 0
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.rgb_gate_evidence: all four GIFs must decode with Pillow as 256x346 GIF images with at least one readable nondegenerate frame
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.point_cloud_gate_evidence: all four raw pre-policy point clouds are stored in an ignored NPZ and independently revalidated as finite, nondegenerate float32 arrays with shape (3,512,512) and matching SHA-256 values
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.bounded_gate_timeouts: 600 seconds per direct/isolated initialization capture and 3600 seconds per episode-0 evaluator, then TERM and a 30-second KILL window
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.checkout_lock: exact startup HEAD is recorded and the clean repro/racer-egl checkout is rechecked after dependency wait and before subsequent gates/full run
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.residual_process_gate: exact run/owner environment markers are scanned through /proc after every capture/evaluation stage; any CoppeliaSim, worker, service, evaluator, Xvfb, or other owned residual fails closed
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.resource_gate: SPR and Guardian tmux sessions terminated and GPUs 1-4 idle for three consecutive checks
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.fallback_limit: one claimed process-isolation path per supervisor ID and at most one fixed episode-0 attempt with zero evaluator retries
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.fallback_prerequisite: direct versus policy-parent/spawn-worker initialization observations match exactly and both capture processes plus the worker exit naturally with status 0
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.fallback_unlock_condition: the only isolated episode attempt exits naturally, reports success=true, and passes the same strict single-episode artifact/native-failure validator
queued_virtualgl_egl_retry.fallback_delivery: implemented; real initialization and episode gates are not run while SPR or Guardian remains active

recommended_display_backend: VirtualGL EGL first; if and only if that gate fails, the single claimed spawn-isolation path may proceed through exact initialization-observation equality and one natural-exit episode before the 75-episode run.
reproduction_boundary: The paper reports five-seed means and standard deviations, while the release provides one actor checkpoint.
